summary: Azul S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC disclosing the suspension of its previously announced cancellation process for common share subscription warrants approved by its Board of Directors. The Company, subject to restrictions under its Chapter 11 plan, decided to halt the cancellation process in cooperation with B3 to protect investor rights and market integrity. Trading of the Subscription Warrants on B3 will remain temporarily suspended while the Company evaluates next steps with B3. This filing updates market participants on procedural status rather than announcing a definitive special situation. What to watch: any subsequent resolution or termination of the warrant suspension and its impact on Azul's restructuring efforts.
